gate_parameters.abstention_tau: 80th percentile of predictive interval widths on the bound CALIBRATION set (SPEC-A section 7.3, ratified). Abstention never removes games from the gate (sections 4.4, 7.1).
gate_parameters.baseline: Homoscedastic Gaussian, mu = archived line at T_emit, sigma fit point-in-time on the scoring window only (expanding, kickoff-strict) (SPEC-A section 3). The frozen-filter baseline 7.154021 is NOT carried over.
gate_parameters.emission: ZERO_OBJECT. RVC: NOT_CLEARED (unchanged by this freeze).
gate_parameters.multiplicity: Holm step-down over the confirmatory family (SPEC-A sections 8.2, 4.3c). Family at FINAL: m = 1 (PRJ-1 sole member); the candidate's fitting procedure, including nu selection, is inside the family (section 8.5). Shadows S-G / S-F2 / S-ALL4 / S-F1 carry no alpha and are reported only (RULING-C1 section 1.5).
gate_parameters.pass_rule: All of SPEC-A section 4.3: (a) delta_hat < 0; (b) one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound excludes 0 (5th percentile < 0); (c) Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
gate_parameters.quantity: Relative paired delta CRPS: mean per-game (CRPS_candidate - CRPS_baseline) on the SCORING set; negative favors the candidate (SPEC-A section 4.1). No absolute CRPS level is specified.
gate_parameters.t_emit: T - 90 minutes before scheduled kickoff; mu from the archiver's stamped capture closest to but not after T_emit (SPEC-A sections 2.2-2.3).
gate_parameters.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over games, B = 10,000 (SPEC-A section 4.2, ratified).

derivation.z_convention_note: The z values are z_0.975 = 1.959964 and z_0.80 = 0.841621 — the convention of the program's own planning artifacts: the sigma-d job's published family (579 at delta 0.0342; 1,693 at delta 0.02; 6,772 at delta 0.01) and SPEC-A section 5.4's table (approx 581 / 1,696 / 6,785) both reproduce only under z_0.975. The literal one-sided reading of section 5.1's z_{1-alpha} symbol (z_0.95 = 1.644854) yields ceil(1333.67) = 1,334. FINAL binds the LARGER value, 1,694: it matches the planning record the ratification relied on, and a larger pre-declared n can only extend the window (section 5.5) — it cannot loosen the gate. The discrepancy between section 5.1's symbol and section 5.4's arithmetic is recorded here, not silently resolved.

pre_declared_n.formula: n = ceil( ((z_{1-alpha} + z_{power}) * sigma_d / delta_min)^2 * DEFF ) (SPEC-A section 5.1)
